entries.87ede5d22a9f4162: FUJIFILM Holdings Corporation is a holding company that started from photographic film manufacturing in 1934 and has extended the materials, optical and imaging technologies cultivated there into contract manufacturing of medical devices and biopharmaceuticals, materials for semiconductors and displays, and office multifunction devices and IT services. In 2006, it transitioned to a holding company structure through a newly established company split that transferred all operations to FUJIFILM Corporation, and as of March 31, 2026, it had 258 subsidiaries and 27 affiliates. The company's production and sales items are highly diverse, and because products of the same type are not uniform in capacity, structure or format, production and order scales by segment are not presented in monetary or quantity terms.
